notes: Modified cash basis school district (cash basis). Governmental lines use the Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts/disbursements statement (p7), which is after the Eliminations column (645,000 of inter-fund transfers removed), so top-level transfers are null and the roll-forward 7,712,196 + 12,864,307 - 11,463,083 = 9,113,420 ties. Business-type = Nutrition Fund (p8-9). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position total column (p1). Detail: GF revenue from the budget schedule (p10); GF spending from the by-department schedule (p16-21), which supersedes the GF budget schedule's function lines (not double counted). Hidden transfers: the p7 Eliminations column shows 495,000 (GF to Depreciation, matching Depreciation Fund 'Transfer from General Fund' p12) inside Staff 80,000, Building and grounds 265,000, Pupil transportation 150,000, and 150,000 (GF to Activity Fund) inside extracurricular; the 150,000 is printed as its own 'Transfer to Activity Fund' line in the GF schedule (other financing, printed_in expenditure); the 495,000 is recorded as contra lines (negative expenditure) plus an other-financing line, so GF detail expenditure lines sum to the printed 10,488,948 less 495,000 contra. Bond Fund and Activity Fund have no separate schedule (statement only). County Treasurer statement (p15) not recorded (reconciling schedule; would double count). Zero-actual lines with budget are recorded with amount 0. Printed dashes in the Total column for Transfer from other funds are not an item. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
